اقتصدنا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَدْنَا (iqtaṣadnā) /iq.ta.sˤad.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# اُقْتُصِدْنَا (uqtuṣidnā) /uq.tu.sˤid.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
